title: Everyone gives you research. We give you a plan - and now, a whole AI research desk with trade planning. 📊
author: One-Cellist-8159
selftext:
Today I am launching the Edge Cipher Terminal: your entire research workflow on one screen.

No more juggling ten tabs. The Terminal puts everything side by side, updating live:

🟢 The Edge, live - our daily watchlist with full trade plans: entry, target, stop, and risk-to-reward. Every pick tracked in the open, so you see exactly how it plays out.  
🟢 Broad View - see where money is rotating before you commit. Sector money-flow map, rotation board, and market context in one glance.  
🟢 Portfolio Lab - load your holdings, X-ray your concentration and overlap, and let the optimizer suggest a better-balanced mix.

And it's your desk - drag, resize, and save your layout. It's waiting for you tomorrow, on the web or in our Windows app.  
Included with every paid plan.

👉 Take the tour: [https://edgecipher.ai/terminal-tour](https://edgecipher.ai/terminal-tour)

comments.body: Interesting concept, but the quality of any AI-generated research depends entirely on the data feeding it. Most generic workflows pulling from free public sources (Yahoo-style feeds) produce shallow analysis. The real edge comes from enterprise-level API access and a structured weighting model that scores and organizes the data *before* the LLM touches it. That's the difference between random prompts and a repeatable system. For a deeper first layer of analysis, trademates.co uses that exact approach with an in-house model and Claude in the background.
